trans-unit.id: Air pollution output is divided by this to determine PPM. It depends on AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 and the world area. For 1km2 and pressure 1kg/m2, 1 ton = 1PPM (part per million), which is the unit that determines climate change effects.
trans-unit.source: Air pollution output is divided by this to determine PPM. It depends on AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 and the world area. For 1km2 and pressure 1kg/m2, 1 ton = 1PPM (part per million), which is the unit that determines climate change effects.
trans-unit.target: 空气污染输出除以此即可确定百万分率。它取决于AtmospherePressureKgPerM2和世界范围。对于1平方千米和压力1公斤 / 平方米，1吨= 1百万分率（百万分之一），这是确定气候变化影响的单位。

trans-unit.id: How much PPM (particles per million) will be added to/removed from atmosphere per one tone of matter (i.e. CO2).
trans-unit.source: How much PPM (particles per million) will be added to/removed from atmosphere per one tone of matter (i.e. CO2).
trans-unit.target: 每一种音调（例如，二氧化碳）将添加到大气中或从大气中去除多少百万分率（百万分之颗粒）。

trans-unit.id: Atmosphere pressure used in the atmosphere size formula. Trees absorb and pollution from tables produced in tons and converted to PPM by dividing on total atmosphere size. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 where WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensions.x * 10) * (Dimensions.y * 10). In example for 1km² (1000000m²) world with atmosphere pressure 1 kg/m² it will be 1000000 tons, resulting in 1 PPM per 1 ton of pollution or absorb (1 PPM = 1000000 * tons / AtmosphereSizeInTons), increasing pressure to 2 will result in 0.5 PPM per ton.
trans-unit.source: Atmosphere pressure used in the atmosphere size formula. Trees absorb and pollution from tables produced in tons and converted to PPM by dividing on total atmosphere size. AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2 where WorldAreaInM2 = (Dimensions.x * 10) * (Dimensions.y * 10). In example for 1km² (1000000m²) world with atmosphere pressure 1 kg/m² it will be 1000000 tons, resulting in 1 PPM per 1 ton of pollution or absorb (1 PPM = 1000000 * tons / AtmosphereSizeInTons), increasing pressure to 2 will result in 0.5 PPM per ton.
trans-unit.target: 大气压公式中使用的大气压。树木吸收并污染了以吨为单位的餐桌，并通过除以大气总大小将其转换为百万分率。 AtmosphereSizeInTons = WorldAreaInM2 * AtmospherePressureKgPerM2，其中WorldAreaInM2 =（Dimensions.x * 10）*（Dimensions.y * 10）。例如，对于大气压力为1 公斤 /m²的1km²（1000000m²）世界，将为1000000吨，即每1吨污染物或吸收量产生1 百万分率（1 百万分率 = 1000000 *吨/ AtmosphereSizeInTons），将压力增加到2将导致每吨0.5 百万分率。

trans-unit.id: A stockpile for distributing items to new players. Allows you to choose a specific set of items which each new player will be able to take.
trans-unit.source: A stockpile for distributing items to new players. Allows you to choose a specific set of items which each new player will be able to take.
trans-unit.target: 一个向新玩家分配物品的料堆。你可以选择每名新玩家都可获得的一组特定物品。

trans-unit.id: A porcelain bathtub for when you need to get clean or just relax.
trans-unit.source: A porcelain bathtub for when you need to get clean or just relax.
trans-unit.target: 一个陶瓷浴缸，给你洗澡和放松的好地方。

trans-unit.id: The assembly line allows for mass production of mechanical products.
trans-unit.source: The assembly line allows for mass production of mechanical products.
trans-unit.target: 装配线允许你大批量生产机械产品。

trans-unit.id: An ashlar stone bench. Great for display though maybe not as comfy as a padded couch.
trans-unit.source: An ashlar stone bench. Great for display though maybe not as comfy as a padded couch.
trans-unit.target: 一把方琢石质长凳。非常适合用于展示，但坐起来，我的评价是：不如沙发。

trans-unit.id: A fancy ashlar stone table that has been adorned with gold.
trans-unit.source: A fancy ashlar stone table that has been adorned with gold.
trans-unit.target: 一张用金子装饰的方琢石桌。

trans-unit.id: All citizens are survivalists in the world of Eco. How can you save the world if you can't save yourself?
trans-unit.source: All citizens are survivalists in the world of Eco. How can you save the world if you can't save yourself?
trans-unit.target: 《生态物语》世界中的所有人都是求生者。一屋不扫，何以扫天下?

trans-unit.id: Metal is an important part of progress and smelting is the first step into a new age. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Metal is an important part of progress and smelting is the first step into a new age. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 金属是一个文明进步的重要组成部分，冶炼乃是进入新时代的第一步。你可以通过制造相关物品升级冶炼技能。

trans-unit.id: Self-improvement increases both the amount of weight citizens can carry and their stomach capacity. It also decreases the calories expended when using hammers and shovels. Experience is gained when leveling up other specialties.
trans-unit.source: Self-improvement increases both the amount of weight citizens can carry and their stomach capacity. It also decreases the calories expended when using hammers and shovels. Experience is gained when leveling up other specialties.
trans-unit.target: 自我提升会增加公民的负重量和他们的卡路里容量，也可以减少使用锤子和铁锹时消耗的卡路里。在升级其他专业时获得自我提升经验。

trans-unit.id: Pottery is an advancement in masonry and can provide an excellent building material for communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Pottery is an advancement in masonry and can provide an excellent building material for communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 陶艺是石工的进步，可以为社区提供优质的建筑材料。通过制作相关物品来升级陶艺技能。

trans-unit.id: Paper to carry the written word. Or used to stuff in bookshelves. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Paper to carry the written word. Or used to stuff in bookshelves. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 纸不仅能记录文字，也能装订成书籍装饰你的书架。通过学习更多的配方解锁技能等级。

trans-unit.id: While it takes some advanced tools and constructions, harvesting and refining oil can be an important step. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: While it takes some advanced tools and constructions, harvesting and refining oil can be an important step. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 虽然收集石油和精炼石油是一件很困难的事情，但这是文明进步或不可缺的步骤。通过制作相关物品升级炼油技能。

trans-unit.id: Hitting rocks with a pickaxe can be surprisingly difficult. Levels up by breaking rocks.
trans-unit.source: Hitting rocks with a pickaxe can be surprisingly difficult. Levels up by breaking rocks.
trans-unit.target: 用鹤嘴锄挖石头可能会非常困难。不停挖矿就可以升级采矿技能。

trans-unit.id: Milling various products can create important materials for baking and other uses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Milling various products can create important materials for baking and other uses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 碾磨各种各样的物品，能为烘烤或其他用途提供重要的原材料。通过制作相关物品升级碾磨技能。

trans-unit.id: Mechanics for more advanced creations. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Mechanics for more advanced creations. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 为更先进的发明创造奠定基础的机械技术。通过制造相关物品升级机械技能。

trans-unit.id: Rocks and mortar can provide a suitable building material alternative to wood. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Rocks and mortar can provide a suitable building material alternative to wood. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 岩石和砂浆结合之后可以成为一种比传统的木材更合适的建筑材料。通过制造相关物品升级石工技能。

trans-unit.id: Wood is a useful resource and cutting down trees is a skill anyone can appreciate. Levels up by felling trees and clearing debris.
trans-unit.source: Wood is a useful resource and cutting down trees is a skill anyone can appreciate. Levels up by felling trees and clearing debris.
trans-unit.target: 要想富，先撸树，砍树人人都喜欢。通过砍树和清理树枝碎屑升级伐木技能。

trans-unit.id: Advanced industrialization to produce larger machines and advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced industrialization to produce larger machines and advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 用来生产更多高科技机器的机器。通过制造相关物品升级工业技能。

trans-unit.id: Hunt animals for skin and meat. Levels up by successfully hunting.
trans-unit.source: Hunt animals for skin and meat. Levels up by successfully hunting.
trans-unit.target: 狩猎动物是为采集它们皮和肉。通过狩猎来升级等级。

trans-unit.id: Glassworkers have improved ability to create glass which can be used as a clear building material or framed in steel to create a more industrial look. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Glassworkers have improved ability to create glass which can be used as a clear building material or framed in steel to create a more industrial look. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 玻璃工人们提高了他们制造玻璃的能力，现在这种玻璃既能作为一种透明的建筑材料，又能采用钢框，打造更具工业感的外观。通过学习更多的配方解锁技能等级。

trans-unit.id: Gathering covers harvesting materials from both the natural environment and human-created farms. Levels up by gathering plants - farmed or natural.
trans-unit.source: Gathering covers harvesting materials from both the natural environment and human-created farms. Levels up by gathering plants - farmed or natural.
trans-unit.target: 从大自然环境或农场中采集和收获材料。可透过采集植物提升等级。

trans-unit.id: Adding additional nutrients to the soil can improve farming yield or, if overdone, ruin it. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Adding additional nutrients to the soil can improve farming yield or, if overdone, ruin it. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 在土壤中添加适量的养分，这样可以提高农业产量。如果量过多，会导致农产物的死亡。通过学习更多的配方解锁技能等级。

trans-unit.id: The art of planting and cultivating flora. Levels up by crafting related recipes and using the hoe.
trans-unit.source: The art of planting and cultivating flora. Levels up by crafting related recipes and using the hoe.
trans-unit.target: 植物栽培是一门艺术。熟能生巧。

trans-unit.id: Electronics improves the recipes for many advanced materials needed for advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Electronics improves the recipes for many advanced materials needed for advanced technology. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 更高级的材料需要更高级的技术，电子技术改善了这种情况。通过学习相关配方解锁技能等级。

trans-unit.id: Cutting edge cooking works with ingredients that don't quite sound like food but can potentially provide high calorie and nutrition. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Cutting edge cooking works with ingredients that don't quite sound like food but can potentially provide high calorie and nutrition. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 尖端烹饪使用听起来不太像食物的原料，但可能会提供高额的热量和营养。制作相关配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: The basics of cooking in a more civilized environment give bonuses to a variety of food recipes. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: The basics of cooking in a more civilized environment give bonuses to a variety of food recipes. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 在更文明的环境中进行基础烹饪，会给予各种食物配方额外加成。制作相关配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: Allows the construction of advanced wood products for furniture and houses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Allows the construction of advanced wood products for furniture and houses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 允许使用高级木制品制作家具和建造房屋。制作相关配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: Cutting logs into usable crafting and building materials is an important skill for budding communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Cutting logs into usable crafting and building materials is an important skill for budding communities. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 将原木切割成可用的制作和建筑材料，是使社区萌芽的一项重要技能。制作相关配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: Advanced techniques for producing food over a campfire with a little less burned and a little more golden brown. Levels up by crafting campfire recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced techniques for producing food over a campfire with a little less burned and a little more golden brown. Levels up by crafting campfire recipes.
trans-unit.target: 在篝火上烹饪的高级技巧，更少的烧焦，更多的烤熟。由制作篝火配方升级。

trans-unit.id: Butchery allows for more usable products to be harvested from hunted animals and fish. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Butchery allows for more usable products to be harvested from hunted animals and fish. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 屠宰工作允许从狩猎的动物和鱼类中收获更有用的产品。制作相关配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: Basic Engineering allows easier construction of roads and gives access to early forms of mechanical power. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Basic Engineering allows easier construction of roads and gives access to early forms of mechanical power. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 基础工程学允许更方便地建造道路，并可获取早期形式的机械动力。制作相关配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: An introduction to cooking with an oven. Levels up by crafting related unleavened recipes.
trans-unit.source: An introduction to cooking with an oven. Levels up by crafting related unleavened recipes.
trans-unit.target: 用烤炉烹饪的入门。制作相关未发酵的配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: Advanced smelting aids in the production of steel - a key ingredient in the progress of any group. Levels up by crafting advanced smelting recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced smelting aids in the production of steel - a key ingredient in the progress of any group. Levels up by crafting advanced smelting recipes.
trans-unit.target: 高级冶炼有助于钢铁的生产——任何团体发展的关键原料。制作高级冶炼配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: Advanced masonry allows the production of high-quality stone furniture and material for houses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced masonry allows the production of high-quality stone furniture and material for houses. Levels up by crafting related recipes.
trans-unit.target: 高级石工允许生产高品质的石制家具和房屋材料。制作相关配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: Advanced cooking techniques for producing more complex foods. Levels up by crafting advanced cooking recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced cooking techniques for producing more complex foods. Levels up by crafting advanced cooking recipes.
trans-unit.target: 高级烹饪技巧，用于生产更复杂的食物。制作高级烹饪配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: Advanced baking mostly improves recipes that involve a leavening agent. Levels up by crafting advanced baking recipes.
trans-unit.source: Advanced baking mostly improves recipes that involve a leavening agent. Levels up by crafting advanced baking recipes.
trans-unit.target: 高级烘培主要提升了涉及膨松剂的相关配方。制作高级烘培配方来提升等级。

trans-unit.id: Basic Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Tailoring recipes.
trans-unit.source: Basic Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Tailoring recipes.
trans-unit.target: 基础升级可大大提高制作裁缝配方时的效率。

trans-unit.id: Modern Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Tailoring recipes.
trans-unit.source: Modern Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Tailoring recipes.
trans-unit.target: 现代升级，可大大提高制作裁缝配方时的效率。

trans-unit.id: Modern Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Mechanics recipes.
trans-unit.source: Modern Upgrade that greatly increases efficiency when crafting Mechanics recipes.
trans-unit.target: 现代升级，可大大提高制作机械配方的效率。

trans-unit.id: An extremely useful synthetic material derived from petrochemicals.
trans-unit.source: An extremely useful synthetic material derived from petrochemicals.
trans-unit.target: 一种非常有用的石油化工合成材料。

trans-unit.id: Provides speed and torque conversions from a rotating power source to another device.
trans-unit.source: Provides speed and torque conversions from a rotating power source to another device.
trans-unit.target: 将旋转动力源的速度和扭矩转换至另一台装置。

trans-unit.id: A crustacean that loves the ocean, just don't get caught in its pinch!
trans-unit.source: A crustacean that loves the ocean, just don't get caught in its pinch!
trans-unit.target: 一种海生甲壳动物，小心你的大拇指！

trans-unit.id: A dressed salad that, with the added sweetness, it's pretty tasty.
trans-unit.source: A dressed salad that, with the added sweetness, it's pretty tasty.
trans-unit.target: 一份精美的沙拉，不咸不淡，味道真是好极了。

trans-unit.id: To give thanks for the fact that this food gives two extra nutrients than other food items of the same tier.
trans-unit.source: To give thanks for the fact that this food gives two extra nutrients than other food items of the same tier.
trans-unit.target: 鸣谢：这个食物比其他同等级的食物要多提供两种营养。

trans-unit.id: A thick stew chock-full of meat and charred vegetables. A surprisingly good combination.
trans-unit.source: A thick stew chock-full of meat and charred vegetables. A surprisingly good combination.
trans-unit.target: 浓稠的汤里塞满了肉和烧焦的蔬菜。这个搭配居然还不错。

trans-unit.id: Comforting, best served hot from the griddle.
trans-unit.source: Comforting, best served hot from the griddle.
trans-unit.target: 针不戳，最好从烤盘上拿下来直接吃。
新鲜木瓜。要是不熟，我自己吃了它。

trans-unit.id: A sweet pastry that is great for breakfast or anytime you need a quick boost of energy.
trans-unit.source: A sweet pastry that is great for breakfast or anytime you need a quick boost of energy.
trans-unit.target: 甜味糕点，适合作为早餐或者其他需要能量的地方。横扫饥饿，做回自己。
油炸卡马斯。像高质量男性一样油。
大孢毛菇，吃了不会躺板板。

trans-unit.id: Agave leaves that have been charred over a campfire.
trans-unit.source: Agave leaves that have been charred over a campfire.
trans-unit.target: 被篝火烧焦的龙舌兰叶。

trans-unit.id: A thick stew chock-full of meat, camas, and corn. A surprisingly good combination.
trans-unit.source: A thick stew chock-full of meat, camas, and corn. A surprisingly good combination.
trans-unit.target: 浓稠的汤里塞满了肉，卡马斯球茎和玉米。这个搭配居然还不错。
可食用牛肝菌。吃了不会躺板板。

trans-unit.id: A multipurpose filler that is made from what you have available.
trans-unit.source: A multipurpose filler that is made from what you have available.
trans-unit.target: 一种多功能填料，由你所拥有的材料所制。

trans-unit.id: An excellent fertilizer that provides a mix of nutrients, but especially potassium.
trans-unit.source: An excellent fertilizer that provides a mix of nutrients, but especially potassium.
trans-unit.target: 一种出色的肥料，可提供多种营养素，尤其是钾。用了之后小麦亩产一千八。

trans-unit.id: A fossil fuel essential for manufacturing gasoline, plastics, and asphalt. Its extraction, transport, and burning all have environmental impacts.
trans-unit.source: A fossil fuel essential for manufacturing gasoline, plastics, and asphalt. Its extraction, transport, and burning all have environmental impacts.
trans-unit.target: 一种用于制造汽油，塑料和沥青的化石燃料。它的提取、运输和燃烧都对环境产生影响。

trans-unit.id: A dusty surface formed by tampering dirt with a road tool. It's servicable for any wheeled vehicle.
trans-unit.source: A dusty surface formed by tampering dirt with a road tool. It's servicable for any wheeled vehicle.
trans-unit.target: 一个用修路工具压实泥土形成的肮脏表面。对任何轮式车辆都很实用。

trans-unit.id: To discover skill, construct a {0} at a {1}.
trans-unit.source: To discover skill, construct a {0} at a {1}.
trans-unit.target: 若要发现技能，在 {1} 处制作一个 {0} 。

trans-unit.id: Shows commands for preforming debugging and hard testing commands.
trans-unit.source: Shows commands for preforming debugging and hard testing commands.

trans-unit.id: This setting defines how plants will be grouped when the world generates. It have two levels of grouping: clusters and groups. A cluster is a large area of the world where a particular type of plant exists, and it affects gameplay by limiting where specific plants can be spawned. Groups are primarily for visual purposes, so plants of the same species grow together with only a small distance between them.
trans-unit.source: This setting defines how plants will be grouped when the world generates. It have two levels of grouping: clusters and groups. A cluster is a large area of the world where a particular type of plant exists, and it affects gameplay by limiting where specific plants can be spawned. Groups are primarily for visual purposes, so plants of the same species grow together with only a small distance between them.
trans-unit.target: 该设置定义了世界生成时植物的聚类方式。聚类分为两个层次：群落和组。群落是指世界中某特定植物类型存在的大片区域，它通过限制特定植物的生成位置来影响游戏玩法。组主要出于视觉效果考虑，因此同种植物会紧密生长在一起，彼此间仅保持很小的距离。

trans-unit.id: When set, citizens will become exhausted after the given number of hours. While exhausted, they cannot spend calories, but can still do other activities like making culture, etc. This setting is used to prevent some players from getting ahead of everyone else by playing many more hours than everyone else.
trans-unit.source: When set, citizens will become exhausted after the given number of hours. While exhausted, they cannot spend calories, but can still do other activities like making culture, etc. This setting is used to prevent some players from getting ahead of everyone else by playing many more hours than everyone else.
trans-unit.target: 一旦设定，市民在经过规定的小时数后会感到疲惫。疲惫期间，他们无法消耗卡路里，但仍可进行其他活动，如创造文化等。此设定旨在防止部分玩家通过比其他人多玩数小时来取得压倒性优势。

trans-unit.id: Embrace the power of the people with this bold t-shirt. Crafted for the champions of equality, this shirt is a rallying cry for collective action. Wear it to stand united with your comrades in the fight for a fairer world!

trans-unit.id: A symbol of wealth and status, this lavish top hat is the crown jewel of the capitalist elite. trans-unit.id: How old records can be grouped. It means it will try to process all last X days of records to group them. trans-unit.source: How old records can be grouped. It means it will try to process all last X days of records to group them. World size has limits but they usually apply when world size bigger than 250x250. If you want size bigger -> then MaxBuildHeight must be less than 320. trans-unit.target: 世界在X-Z轴上的区块尺寸。这两个维度必须具有相同的数值，且必须能被4整除。世界大小存在限制，但这些限制通常仅在世界尺寸大于250x250时才会生效。若需更大的尺寸——>，则MaxBuildHeight必须小于320。例如：尺寸为300时最大高度为238，400时为134，以此类推。

trans-unit.id: Maximum height of the world citizens may build to. Can't be lowered after world creation. Note that values bigger than 160 will heavily increase CPU and RAM resources needed for world. Has hard limit for 320. Should not be lower than MaxGenerationHeight. World dimensions product ((Length * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Width * 10)) must be less than max value if INT, so values can be clamped to lower on server start.
trans-unit.source: Maximum height of the world citizens may build to. Can't be lowered after world creation. Note that values bigger than 160 will heavily increase CPU and RAM resources needed for world. Has hard limit for 320. Should not be lower than MaxGenerationHeight. World dimensions product ((Length * 10) * MaxBuildHeight * (Width * 10)) must be less than max value if INT, so values can be clamped to lower on server start.
trans-unit.target: 世界公民可建造的最高高度。 世界创建后无法降低。请注意，数值大于160将大幅增加世界所需的CPU和内存资源。上限为320。不应低于MaxGenerationHeight。世界尺寸的乘积（（长度 * 10）* MaxBuildHeight * （宽度 * 10））必须小于整数最大值，因此服务器启动时数值可能会被限制在更低的范围内。

trans-unit.id: Specifies the formula or curve that controls the shape of how the audio fades between the ConversationalDistance and the AudibleDistance. (1:InverseByDistance) - Fades voice quickly at first, buts slows down as you get further from conversational distance. (2:LinearByDistance) - Fades voice slowly at first, but speeds up as you get further from conversational distance. (3:ExponentialByDistance) - Voice within conversational distance is louder, but fades quickly beyond it.
trans-unit.source: Specifies the formula or curve that controls the shape of how the audio fades between the ConversationalDistance and the AudibleDistance. (1:InverseByDistance) - Fades voice quickly at first, buts slows down as you get further from conversational distance. (2:LinearByDistance) - Fades voice slowly at first, but speeds up as you get further from conversational distance. (3:ExponentialByDistance) - Voice within conversational distance is louder, but fades quickly beyond it.
trans-unit.target: 指定控制音频在“对话距离”与“可听距离”之间淡入淡出形状的公式或曲线。（1:InverseByDistance）——起初声音快速淡出，但随着距离超过对话距离，淡出速度逐渐减慢。（2:LinearByDistance）——起初声音缓慢淡出，但随着距离超过对话距离，淡出速度逐渐加快。 (3:ExponentialByDistance) - 对话距离内的声音更响亮，但超出该距离后会迅速衰减。

trans-unit.id: Controls the amplitude of the curve to make the attenuation of the voice chat loudness more or less extreme.

trans-unit.id: Defines how the penalty percentage scales between the start and maximum pollution values. Possible values: Linear (penalty increases uniformly), Exponential (penalty increases slowly at first, then rapidly at high pollution), Logarithmic (penalty is strong at low pollution, then flattens at higher values), DoubleSigmoid (penalty increases strongly at low pollution, slows near mid-range, then increases strongly again near maximum pollution).
trans-unit.source: Defines how the penalty percentage scales between the start and maximum pollution values. Possible values: Linear (penalty increases uniformly), Exponential (penalty increases slowly at first, then rapidly at high pollution), Logarithmic (penalty is strong at low pollution, then flattens at higher values), DoubleSigmoid (penalty increases strongly at low pollution, slows near mid-range, then increases strongly again near maximum pollution).
trans-unit.target: 定义了从起始污染值到最大污染值之间，惩罚百分比的增长规律。 可能的数值：线性（惩罚值均匀增加）、指数（惩罚值起初缓慢增加，高污染时急速增加）、对数（低污染时惩罚值较强，高污染时趋于平稳）、双S曲线（低污染时惩罚值急剧增加，中段趋缓，接近最大污染值时再次急剧增加）。

trans-unit.id:
Defines a set of blocks that must exist, or not exist on a property. This can be used for all kinds of things:
 - Removing unwanted plants
 - Removing pollution
 - Planting fields (planted blocks must exist)
 - Removing structures or obstacles.

If {Text.Info(Surface)} is checked, only surface blocks will be examined. Otherwise, blocks to a depth of {Text.Info(5)} below the highest block will be examined.
trans-unit.source:
Defines a set of blocks that must exist, or not exist on a property. This can be used for all kinds of things:
 - Removing unwanted plants
 - Removing pollution
 - Planting fields (planted blocks must exist)
 - Removing structures or obstacles.

If {Text.Info(Surface)} is checked, only surface blocks will be examined. Otherwise, blocks to a depth of {Text.Info(5)} below the highest block will be examined.
trans-unit.target:
定义了一组必须存在或不存在于某地块上的方块。这可用于各种用途：
 - 清除不需要的植物
 - 清除污染
 - 开垦农田（已种植的方块必须存在）
 - 拆除建筑物或障碍物。

如果勾选了 {Text.Info(Surface)}，则仅检查地表方块。 否则，将检查最高方块下方深度为 {Text.Info(5)} 的方块。

trans-unit.id: This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. When using this clause, the contract can no longer be auto-approved, and the client will have to approve it before accepting it. When accepting a contract with a custom clause, it is wise to first review the reputation of the citizen offering it, because it is fully at their discretion to approve or deny its completion.\n\nYou must uncheck {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} at the bottom of the contract to use this clause.
trans-unit.source: This clause allows players to define in words what they would like done. When using this clause, the contract can no longer be auto-approved, and the client will have to approve it before accepting it. When accepting a contract with a custom clause, it is wise to first review the reputation of the citizen offering it, because it is fully at their discretion to approve or deny its completion.\n\nYou must uncheck {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} at the bottom of the contract to use this clause.
trans-unit.target: 此条款允许玩家用文字明确说明他们希望采取的行动。 使用此条款后，合约将无法自动批准，客户必须在接受前予以批准。接受包含自定义条款的合约时，建议先查看发布该合约的公民声望，因为是否批准其完成完全由该公民自行决定。\n\n您必须取消勾选合约底部的 {Text.Info(Auto-Approve)} 选项才能使用此条款。

trans-unit.id: Defines a container that must contain a set of objects. Both you and the contractor must have access rights on the selected container.\n\nYou can automatically give the contractor access rights to the container for the term of the contract with an additional Permissions contract clause.
trans-unit.source: Defines a container that must contain a set of objects. Both you and the contractor must have access rights on the selected container.\n\nYou can automatically give the contractor access rights to the container for the term of the contract with an additional Permissions contract clause.
trans-unit.target: 定义了一个必须包含一组对象的容器。您和承包商都必须对所选容器拥有访问权限。\n\n您可以通过添加“权限”合同条款，在合同期限内自动授予承包商对该容器的访问权限。

trans-unit.id:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.

There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: 
 - Reputation, which is the sum of all player's ratings.
 - Relative Reputation, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).

You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.source:
This clause allows you to restrict the acceptance of a contract to only those that have a reputation equal to or greater than the defined amount.

There are two kinds of reputation you can specify here: 
 - Reputation, which is the sum of all player's ratings.
 - Relative Reputation, which is the sum of the opinions from players you have rated favorably (and who they have rated favorably, etc).

You can review the reputations of all players on the server through the citizen list, which displays players in reputation order, and displays reviews from other players in the reputation tooltip.
trans-unit.target:
此条款允许您将合同的接受范围限制为声望值等于或高于指定数值的用户。

您可以在此处指定两种声望类型：
 - 声望值，即所有玩家评分之和。
 - 相对声望，即你给予好评的玩家（以及他们给予好评的玩家等）的意见总和。

你可以通过公民列表查看服务器上所有玩家的声望，该列表按声望值排序，并在声望提示框中显示其他玩家的评价。

This clause will grant the contractor authorization to the selected object or property. Authorization can be granted temporarily for the length of the contract, or it can be given permanently. This permission can be given at either the beginning or end of the contract.

Enabling VSync tells your graphics card to synchronize its actions with your monitor. That means the graphics card is only allowed to render things to the monitor when the monitor says it is ready to repaint a new screen.
Performance impact: Average

Enabling VSync tells your graphics card to synchronize its actions with your monitor. That means the graphics card is only allowed to render things to the monitor when the monitor says it is ready to repaint a new screen.

trans-unit.id:
Annexing a target requires paying them Claim Papers from the source settlement. Unlike resources, these 100% go to the foundation of the target without waste. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
In the case of annexing a Homestead, this number will be increased by the number of Homestead Support Claim Papers that are on the stake. This makes the support claims not only allow homesteads to claim more plots, but have more protection against annexation.
trans-unit.source:
Annexing a target requires paying them Claim Papers from the source settlement. Unlike resources, these 100% go to the foundation of the target without waste. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
In the case of annexing a Homestead, this number will be increased by the number of Homestead Support Claim Papers that are on the stake. This makes the support claims not only allow homesteads to claim more plots, but have more protection against annexation.
trans-unit.target:
吞并目标地区需要向其支付源自母定居点的“索赔文件”。与资源不同，这些文件将100%无损耗地计入目标地区的基建资金。成本根据目标地区内未被遗弃的公民人数计算。
若吞并的是农庄，该数值将增加已押注的“农庄支持索赔书”数量。这使得支持索赔不仅能让农庄申领更多地块，还能增强其抵御吞并的能力。

trans-unit.id:
The resources shown must exist in storage attached to an Embassy Desk that is assigned to the Settlement's jurisdiction. They must be accessible to the leader of the Settlement. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.
Upon annexation, a percent of these will be given to the other party, and the rest destroyed as the cost of the annexation.
If all citizens of a target are 'Abandoned', no resources are needed.
trans-unit.source:
The resources shown must exist in storage attached to an Embassy Desk that is assigned to the Settlement's jurisdiction. They must be accessible to the leader of the Settlement. The cost is determined per-non-abandoned citizen in the target.

trans-unit.target:
显示的资源必须存放在隶属于该定居点管辖范围的大使馆办公桌所连接的仓库中，且定居点领袖必须能够访问这些资源。成本根据目标区域内未被“遗弃”的公民人数计算。
在吞并过程中，其中一部分资源将作为吞并成本分配给对方，其余部分将被销毁。
如果目标区域的所有公民均被“遗弃”，则无需消耗任何资源。

trans-unit.id:
Note that 'Integrity' is not the same as 'Durability'.
Integrity is the max Durability that an object can be repaired to, which drops each time it's repaired. Repairing raises the durability of an item to the current Integrity, but Integrity can never be raised, only lowered.
trans-unit.source:
Note that 'Integrity' is not the same as 'Durability'.
Integrity is the max Durability that an object can be repaired to, which drops each time it's repaired. Repairing raises the durability of an item to the current Integrity, but Integrity can never be raised, only lowered.
trans-unit.target:
请注意，“完整度”与“耐久度”并非同一概念。
完整度是指物品修复后所能达到的最高耐久度，且每次修复都会降低该数值。修复会将物品的耐久度提升至当前完整度，但完整度本身无法提升，只能降低。

trans-unit.id: A specialized sorting unit that processes biological waste materials, including food matter and fabrics. By analyzing material composition, it separates organic material for composting from reusable textile fibers for recovery and recycling.
trans-unit.source: A specialized sorting unit that processes biological waste materials, including food matter and fabrics. By analyzing material composition, it separates organic material for composting from reusable textile fibers for recovery and recycling.

trans-unit.id: A bulk material sorting system designed for construction and demolition waste. Through a series of graded mesh screens, it separates mixed debris into glass fragments, ceramic waste, and stone rubble for specialized recycling.
trans-unit.source: A bulk material sorting system designed for construction and demolition waste. Through a series of graded mesh screens, it separates mixed debris into glass fragments, ceramic waste, and stone rubble for specialized recycling.
trans-unit.target: 一种专为建筑和拆除废料设计的散装物料分拣系统。该系统通过一系列不同规格的筛网，将混合废料分离为玻璃碎片、陶瓷废料和石块碎屑，以便进行专项回收。

trans-unit.id: A mechanical sorting system that processes mixed garbage and separates it into primary recycling types. Materials are categorized according to the fractioanl composition of the incoming waste, producing Mixed blocks of varies types, Bio Residue, Metal Scrap, Construction Scrap and Industrial Waste.
trans-unit.source: A mechanical sorting system that processes mixed garbage and separates it into primary recycling types. Materials are categorized according to the fractioanl composition of the incoming waste, producing Mixed blocks of varies types, Bio Residue, Metal Scrap, Construction Scrap and Industrial Waste.
trans-unit.target: 一种机械分拣系统，用于处理混合垃圾并将其分拣为主要回收类别。该系统根据进料垃圾的成分比例对物料进行分类，产出各类混合块、生物残渣、金属废料、建筑废料和工业废料。

trans-unit.id: A multi-stage recycling system that handles complex industrial waste streams. Combining electricity separation, carbon processing, and mesh filtration, it extracts electronic waste, plastics, and hazardous pollutants into distinct categories for treatment and recovery.
trans-unit.source: A multi-stage recycling system that handles complex industrial waste streams. Combining electricity separation, carbon processing, and mesh filtration, it extracts electronic waste, plastics, and hazardous pollutants into distinct categories for treatment and recovery.
trans-unit.target: 一种用于处理复杂工业废物流的多阶段回收系统。该系统结合了电分离、碳处理和网筛过滤技术，将电子废弃物、塑料和有害污染物分离为不同类别，以便进行处理和回收。

trans-unit.id: An advanced metal recovery system that processes mixed metallic scrap. Using a combination of magnetic separation and chemical extraction, it isolates iron, copper, and gold into individual blocks for recycling.
trans-unit.source: An advanced metal recovery system that processes mixed metallic scrap. Using a combination of magnetic separation and chemical extraction, it isolates iron, copper, and gold into individual blocks for recycling.
trans-unit.target: 一种用于处理混合金属废料的先进金属回收系统。该系统结合了磁选和化学萃取技术，将铁、铜和金分离出来，形成单独的块状物以供回收利用。

trans-unit.source: A basic container to put garbage into, should probably replace it when you can. Better than a stockpile but still contaminates surroundings.

trans-unit.id: What to do when this filter runs out of catalyst. ON: let the incoming fluid pass straight through unfiltered (keeps the line flowing, but it isn't cleaned). OFF: stop and hold the fluid back until catalyst is restocked.

trans-unit.source: Paste an OAuth 2 access token made in your mod.io account, under API access. A read-only token is enough to follow private collections and your subscriptions; subscribing from this server needs one with read+write access. The token is saved in Configs/ModKit.eco, as ModIoAccessToken.

trans-unit.id:
The amount this store always keeps in its bank account.
Buy offers only spend the money above it: once paying for an item would take the account below this amount, the store stops buying and customers can no longer sell to it, until the balance goes back up. Sales are not affected.
Use it to keep money aside for wages, taxes or anything else paid from the same account. Customers only see how much the store can still pay.
0 means no minimum: the store can spend its whole balance.
